name: discovery-tools
description: Agents, skills, and starter kits for Microsoft Discovery — the AI for Science platform. Life-sciences data skills for SABIO-RK, BRENDA, BioCyc/EcoCyc/CyanoCyc, AlphaFold DB, and Rhea/ChEBI/MetaNetX/UniProt identifier crosswalks, plus cross-domain skills for scientific database access, evidence QC, Discovery agent deployment and task design, workspace token-usage mining, live project dashboards, evidence-true project story replays, arxiv-ready paper builds, and DOE literature retrieval. Every skill declares its scientific category and subfield.
